Sysbench Throughput Jitter — per-second TPS distribution

Tip: Ctrl/Cmd-click to select multiple.
"off" runs (thread pool disabled) are unaffected by the oversubscribe selection.
Violins expose bimodal jitter (normal vs stall seconds) that boxes flatten into whiskers. Circle draws a single marker at the median (sample points do not apply).
Each box summarises the per-second TPS samples of one configuration at one client thread count; the dots are the individual seconds (evenly downsampled). Wide boxes and long tails = unstable throughput. At most 12 series are drawn — narrow the selection when the warning appears. Tip: double-click a legend entry to isolate one series; double-click again to bring the others back. Click a data point to download its log files. Shareable URL parameters: ?display=graph|table&metric=tps|lat95&shape=box|violin|circle&points=all|outliers|none&median=lines,bars|none&server=...&mem=2,32&tp=off,80&os=2,3&hide=... (each list also accepts all; hide lists series switched off via legend clicks and updates automatically).
